title: Xperi Inc. Announces Participation in the BWS Financial Growth and Value Summer Investor Series
summary: Xperi Inc. (NYSE: XPER) (the “Company” or “Xperi”), an entertainment technology company that invents, develops, and delivers technologies that enable extraordinary experiences, today announced that CEO Jon Kirchner and CFO Robert Andersen will host meetings at the BWS Financial Growth and Value Summer Investor Series on August 25, 2026, at the AMA Conference Center in New York City. If you would like to schedule a meeting with Xperi Inc., please reach out to your BWS representative or email IR@xperi.com . About Xperi Inc. Xperi invents, develops, and delivers technologies that enable extraordinary experiences. Xperi technologies, delivered via its brands (DTS®, HD Radio™, TiVo®) are integrated into consumer devices and media platforms worldwide, powering smart devices, connected cars and entertainment experiences, including IMAX® Enhanced, a certification and licensing program operated by IMAX Corporation and DTS, Inc.
